3. Open the coupon panel, type the invalid code and click Redeem

specs.title: Valid coupon on the payment step

steps.title: Precondition: set up the saved address, the saved card and the basket, then log in
1. Open the basket and click Checkout
2. Select the saved address and click Continue
3. Select One Day Delivery and click Continue
4. Open the coupon panel, type the coupon code and click Redeem
5. Select the saved card and click Continue
Precondition: set up the saved address and the saved card, put one product into the basket, top up the wallet, then log in
1. Open the basket, click Checkout, select the saved address and click Continue
2. Select Standard Delivery and click Continue
3. Read the button Pay 8.99¤
4. Open the order history
5. Open the digital wallet
Precondition: top up the wallet with the saved card so that the balance equals the order total
6. Open the basket, click Checkout, select the saved address, select Standard Delivery and click Continue
7. Click Pay 8.99¤
8. Click Place your order and pay
9. Open the digital wallet
10. Open the order history
